about: The snapshots the truth is built from, as made by scripts/truth/fetch-sources.ts, with the hash and size of each whole file so a new edition is a visible change. The hand files are the statements typed by a person; they are not snapshots.

gcat-satcat.madeWith: reduced to the rows of the objects the hand files name, in the columns JCAT, Satcat, Launch_Tag, Piece, Type, Name, PLName, LDate, Status, Owner, State, OpOrbit, every kept cell verbatim

gcat-orgs.madeWith: reduced to the owners of those objects and the chain of their parents, in the columns Code, UCode, StateCode, Type, Class, ShortName, Name, Parent, EName
